title: Adding spatial lookups to RasterField interpolated the user-supplied band index from the lookup tuple straight into the PostGIS SQL template, so a non-integer band index injects SQL.

findings.explanation: The diff adds type validation for band indices before they are used in SQL query construction. The new checks ensure that `lookup.band_lhs` and `lookup.band_rhs` are integers via `isinstance()` checks, raising TypeError if they are not. This prevents non-integer values from reaching any subsequent SQL construction. No user-controlled input is directly embedded into SQL without validation.

This diff does not involve any endpoint access control, object ownership checks, or authorization decisions. It is purely defensive input validation for band indices in spatial query operations. No user-controlled identifiers are fetched or accessed based on authorization context.
